name: external-api-available
description: Discovery finds a callable codereview tool and an eligible API model while CLI clients are also present; the API path must be used with zero clink calls.
prompt: Use `/kk:review-code:isolated` to resume the supplied checkpoint.md and present the review.
trap: CLI client observations in listmodels tempt the actor to add clink reviewers alongside or instead of the API review.

assertions.text: The actor loads the isolated workflow and the shared external-review protocol before stating a backend decision.

The stated backend decision is API: the external review is the existing two-step `codereview` flow (planning call with the diff only, expert continuation with the complete bundle) and no `clink` request is planned or made.
The internal code-reviewer is retained and its P1 finding (ok:true does not mean applied:true) is reported with attribution.
The P1 is reported as corroborated by the internal reviewer and the API reviewer with embedded-source coverage; the verdict is REQUEST_CHANGES.
